biography.value:
Description

This brilliantly colored mature adult dragon has scales, teeth, and claws made of multicolored crystal, and its wings are sheets of flexible glass.

Defense

AC 41, touch 6, flat-footed 40 (+35 natural, -4 size)

hp 356 [483] (23d12+225)

mp 180

Fort +24, Ref +17, Will +19

DR 15/magic;

Immune Paralysis, Sleep;

SR 29

Offense

Speed 60 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 250 ft. (clumsy)

Melee Bite +32 (4d6+18 plus 2d6 non-elemental damage/19-20), 2 Claws +31 (2d8+12 plus 1d6 non-elemental damage), 2 Wings +29 (2d6+6 plus 1d6 non-elemental damage), Tail Slap +29 (2d8+18 plus 1d6 non-elemental damage)

Space 20 ft.; Reach 15 ft. (20 ft. with bite)

Special Abilities Crimson Roar, Dragon Force

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (60-ft. Cone, 24d4 non-elemental damage, Reflex DC 30 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Crush (Medium Creatures, DC 30, 4d6+18), Heaven's Cataract, Miasma, Mighty Roar, Tail Sweep (Small Creatures, 2d6+18, DC 30)

Spells Known (FC CL 23th, Concentration +32)

At will (DC 19) - Amanuensis, Detect Magic, Mending, Message Moment, Read Magic

1st (DC 20) - Anticipate Peril, Deceleration, Mage Armor, True Strike

2nd (DC 21) - Clockwork Timer, Delay Response, Lesser Celerity, Recall Agony, Slow Magic, Time Shudder

3rd (DC 22) - Alter Fortune, Blink, Dimension Step, Dispel, Haste, Mass Deceleration, Slow

4th (DC 23) - Baleful Blink, Celerity, Dimension Door, Temporal Jolt, Time Shield

5th (DC 24) - Anticipatory Strike, Greater Blink, Second Chance, Temporary Repair

6th (DC 25) - 24 Hours, Age Resistance, Contingency, Greater Dispel, Hastega, Mass Recall Agony, Slowga

7th (DC 26) - Déjà vu, Fate of One, Lesser Time Stop, Reverse, Slow Skin, Stop, Time Spellsurge

8th (DC 27) - Greater Celerity, Moment of Prescience, Recall Death, Withering

Statistics

Str 35, Dex 10, Con 29, Int 22, Wis 23, Cha 28

Base Atk +23; CMB +39; CMD 49 (53 vs. trip)

Feats Deceitful, Great Fortitude, Hover, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite), Wingover

Skills Appraise +34, Bluff +41, Climb +48, Disguise +38, Fly +14, Intimidate +37, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +34, Knowledge (geography) +34, Perception +34, Sense Motive +34, Stealth +15, Survival +34; Racial Modifiers +8 Climb

Languages Common, Draconic +6 others (DM's choice)

SQ Razor Sharp

description.value: Once every 1d2 rounds as a standard action, with a great, heaving breath does the crystal dragon belch forth a cloud of noxious mist. As a standard action, the crystal dragon deals 5d6 non-elemental damage to all enemies in a 30 ft. cone; a successful Reflex save (DC 30) halves this damage. All enemies within the area of effect who failed the Reflex save must make a series of saves (DC 30) to avoid each of the following effects: Disease (Fort), Silence (Will), Sap (Fort), and Slow (Will), all of which last for 1d8 rounds. The crystal dragon must wait 1d4 rounds before using this ability again. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th-level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, the crystal dragon brings out a mighty roar. Any creature within the area is deafened for 6d6 rounds, stunned for 1 round, and takes 15d6 points of non-elemental damage. Any exposed brittle or crystalline object or crystalline creature takes 1d6 points of non-elemental damage per caster level (maximum 20d6). A creature in the area of the cone can negate the stunning and halve both the damage and the duration of the deafness with a successful Fortitude save (DC 30). A creature holding vulnerable objects can attempt a Reflex save to negate the damage to those objects. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31).

actions.name: Mighty Roar

save.description: Half damage and deafness; negates stun

effect: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, the crystal dragon brings out a mighty roar. Any creature within the area is deafened for 6d6 rounds, stunned for 1 round, and takes 15d6 points of non-elemental damage. Any exposed brittle or crystalline object or crystalline creature takes 1d6 points of non-elemental damage per caster level (maximum 20d6). A creature in the area of the cone can negate the stunning and halve both the damage and the duration of the deafness with a successful Fortitude save (DC 30). A creature holding vulnerable objects can attempt a Reflex save to negate the damage to those objects. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31).

description.value: All of a crystal dragon's natural attacks deal slashing damage.

A crystal dragon radiates an aura of scintillating color from its jeweled scales to a radius of 60 feet. All within this area must make a Will save each round to avoid being stunned (if the victim has 15 or fewer Hit Dice) or confused (if the victim has more than 15 Hit Dice) for 1 round. The save DC is equal to the dragon's breath weapon save DC. This is a mind-affecting effect. The dragon can activate or suppress this aura as a free action.
